attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: ECOS India Mobility and Hospitality Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of Rs 2,345.06 Mn, a 9.48% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 13.78% to Rs 279.5 Mn with an 11.92% margin. Profit after tax grew 21.40% to Rs 177.32 Mn. The company recorded 1.58 million trips in the quarter, bringing H1 FY27 total trips beyond 3 million. Active clients reached 1,538, and the fleet expanded to over 20,500 vehicles across 160 cities. The Chairman stated the balance sheet is debt-free. The presentation includes historical financials showing consistent growth since listing in FY25. It outlines industry drivers such as the expansion of Global Capability Centers and improved airport connectivity. The company operates an asset-light model with a 90% vendor-owned fleet. Service offerings include chauffeur-driven mobility for corporate and institutional clients across economy, premium, and luxury segments.

attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "Prese Release on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026".
voiceSummary: ECOS India Mobility and Hospitality Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27 ended on September 30th, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 2,345.06 million rupees, an increase of 9.48 percent year-on-year. EBITDA rose 13.78 percent year-on-year to 279.49 million rupees, with a margin of 11.92 percent. Profit after tax grew 21.40 percent year-on-year to 177.32 million rupees. The company completed 1.58 million trips, expanding its presence to 160 cities. The board of directors held a meeting on November 13rd, 2026, to review these results. Shareholders had previously approved a final dividend of 2.38 rupees per equity share for the financial year 2026 at the annual general meeting on September 21st, 2026. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with cash and investments of 1,256.11 million rupees.

attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: XTGlobal Infotech Limited, Sonal Adhesives Limited, TARC Limited, Celebrity Fashions Limited, Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited, and Dilip Buildcon Limited have approved their unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at meetings held between November 12 and November 13, 2026. Dilip Buildcon reported standalone net profit after tax of 9,093.74 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. TARC Limited, Celebrity Fashions Limited, Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited, Sonal Adhesives Limited, and XTGlobal Infotech Limited have made the results available on their respective websites and stock exchange platforms. Dilip Buildcon also disclosed consolidated net profit after tax of 21,407.20 lakhs for the same quarter.

attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026, accompanied by a Limited Review Report. Additionally, the Board approved the constitution of the Strategy and Performance Review Committee along with its terms of reference. The meeting commenced at 12:15 PM and concluded at 16:30 PM IST. The financial results are attached to the original filing.

attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited has announced an earnings conference call for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. The discussion will cover operational and financial performance. Participants include Chairman and Managing Director Rajesh Loomba, Joint Managing Director Adity Loomba, Chief Operating Officer Deepali Dev, and Chief Financial Officer Hem Kumar Upadhyay. Access numbers and a registration link are available on the company website.
